notes.title: New Update: RIVALS SQUAD v2.0 is here!
notes.notes:
Explosive New Update: RIVALS SQUAD v2.0 is here!

🚀 Get ready for a whole new gaming experience with the latest update to RIVALS SQUAD. Immerse yourself in the action with gameplay enhancements and a dramatic redesign of the lobby interface for total immersion.

Highlights of this Update :

Improved Gameplay: Experience more intense and fluid combat thanks to tactical adjustments, redesigned weapons and refined gameplay mechanics.

Redesigned User Interface: The lobby is now more intuitive and aesthetically pleasing, offering smoother navigation for optimal pre-battle preparation.

Advanced Customization: Explore new customization options for your avatars, with all-new skins and accessories to stand out on the battlefield.

New Challenges and Rewards: Stimulating challenges have been added for exclusive rewards, putting your strategic skills to the test.

General improvements: Adjustments and fixes have been made for an even more immersive and seamless gameplay experience.

New: A tutorial has been added at the start of the game to teach the basics of gameplay.

Get ready to jump into the action and discover a thrilling adventure with RIVALS SQUAD v2.0 right now!

The update will be available on [release date]. Get ready to join the arena with incredible enhancements for an unparalleled gaming experience.

notes.title: BOT V2 UPDATE
notes.notes: We are pleased to announce the updates to Bots v2. You can now enjoy fighting advanced bots. Several bug fixes and performance improvements.

notes.title: UPDATE : ADDING BOT
notes.notes: You asked for the AI ​​pendant for your games and so we listened to the communities! This is the first version, there will be updates with a more intelligent AI and with more features. Comment on this addition and we will do our best to improve the game.

notes.title: PARACHUTE UPDATE
notes.notes:
We wanted to give more fun and responsiveness to the game. So we added the Parachute that you can open when you fall to avoid damage and also be able to move faster.

In this version of the game new features have been added and above all improved. Lots of bugs have been fixed. We have also integrated the first version of the bots to give more life to your games

[b]We were working hard on our game and we are a small independent studio, but we are trying to update as much as possible to make the game as pleasant and fun as possible. Lots of additions to come[/b]
